# `silk/markdown/text`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Visible text, heading slugs, and document outlines for Markdown trees.

## When to use
Use `MarkdownText.plainTextOwned` to extract text and `MarkdownText.outline` to collect headings.
Use `MarkdownSlugger` for unique GitHub-style anchors across a sequence of headings.

## Details
Text extraction omits raw HTML and frontmatter. Image children contribute their alternative text.
Slugs use Unicode lowercase, remove punctuation except hyphens and underscores, and replace spaces with hyphens.

## Examples

### Collect unique heading anchors

```silk
import silk.markdown.document { MarkdownDocument }
import silk.markdown.text { MarkdownText, MarkdownHeading }
import silk.collections.list { List }
import silk.text.string { String }
import silk.core.effect { Effect }
import silk.mem.allocator { Allocator, OutOfMemoryError }

pub effect fn main() -> i32
  ! OutOfMemoryError {
  let mut allocator = Allocator.systemAllocatorProvider()
  let document = run MarkdownDocument.parse("# Hello\n\n# Hello")
    |> Effect.provideMut<Allocator>(&mut allocator)
  let headings = run MarkdownText.outline(&document) |> Effect.provideMut<Allocator>(&mut allocator)
  let rows = List<MarkdownHeading>.asSlice(&headings)
  if rows.length != 2 || String.view(&rows[1].slug) != "hello-1" {
    return 1
  }
  return 0
}
```

Import as `MarkdownText` with `import silk.markdown.text { MarkdownText }`.

<a id="MarkdownSlugger"></a>

## `MarkdownSlugger`

```silk
pub struct MarkdownSlugger
```

Reusable state for unique GitHub-style slugs. Repeated slugs receive `-1`, `-2`, and later available suffixes.
Explicit suffixed names also reserve their spelling. Create separate state for each document.

Returns a lowercase slug unique within this state, reserving its spelling.
Removes punctuation except `-` and `_`, replaces ASCII spaces with `-`, and preserves repeated spaces.

- `OutOfMemoryError` if slug storage cannot grow. Earlier reserved slugs remain reserved.

<a id="MarkdownText.impl.plainTextInto"></a>

### Associated function `plainTextInto`

```silk
pub effect fn plainTextInto(
    document: &MarkdownDocument<'_>,
    id: MarkdownNodeId,
    out: &mut Bytes,
  ) -> ()
    ! OutOfMemoryError
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Appends visible text from subtree `id` to `out`. Invalid ids append nothing.
Text, code, and image alternatives contribute text. Breaks and block boundaries contribute newlines; table cells use tabs.
Raw HTML and frontmatter contribute no text. Footnote references contribute their number; nested definitions are skipped.

#### Errors

- `OutOfMemoryError` if `out` cannot grow. Text already appended remains in `out`.

Returns owned visible text for subtree `id`. Invalid ids return empty text.
Text, code, and image alternatives contribute text. Breaks and block boundaries contribute newlines; table cells use tabs.
Raw HTML and frontmatter contribute no text. Footnote references contribute their number; nested definitions are skipped.

#### Errors

- `OutOfMemoryError` if the allocator cannot supply the result.

<a id="MarkdownText.impl.slugOwned"></a>

### Associated function `slugOwned`

```silk
pub effect fn slugOwned(value: string) -> String
    ! OutOfMemoryError
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Returns a GitHub-style slug without duplicate tracking.
Uses Unicode lowercase, removes punctuation except `-` and `_`, and replaces ASCII spaces with `-`.
Tabs and control characters are removed. Non-ASCII letters, combining marks, and numbers remain.

#### Errors

- `OutOfMemoryError` if the allocator cannot supply the result.

<a id="MarkdownText.impl.outline"></a>

### Associated function `outline`

```silk
pub effect fn outline(document: &MarkdownDocument<'_>) -> List<MarkdownHeading>
    ! OutOfMemoryError
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Returns headings in document order with owned visible text and unique slugs.
Duplicate tracking starts empty for each call. The returned ids belong to `document`.
Headings inside footnote definitions are excluded because definitions are not part of the document outline.

#### Errors

- `OutOfMemoryError` if the allocator cannot supply the outline or its strings.
